# DTE — Data Transformation Engine

> DTE is a batch data transformation engine. Connect a source, map fields once
> with a no-code pipeline builder, and write to any destination — no one-off
> scripts, no glue code.

## What it does

- **Sources**: Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob, Postgres, MongoDB,
  REST APIs (paginated), local filesystem (JSON/CSV/Parquet/Excel).
- **Transform steps**: filter (SQL WHERE), rename, retype, map/lookup, map/expression,
  sort, aggregate (group-by with sum/count/avg/min/max), join (inner/left/right/outer),
  pivot, select/drop fields.
- **Data quality**: check (assert a SQL rule, fail or warn), profile (null %,
  distinct count, min/max), and a dry-run preview before every run.
- **Destinations**: Postgres (upsert), SQL databases, Parquet on S3, JSON/CSV/Excel
  files, REST endpoint.
- Pipelines are mapped once and triggered on a schedule or on demand via API —
  the pipeline is the same asset whether it runs manually or from an orchestrator.

## Who it's for

Teams who need to move and reshape data between systems (source system →
warehouse, API → database, files → warehouse) without hand-writing and
maintaining one-off Python/SQL scripts for every integration.
